title: Regular-section exact sequences give lower-dimensional differences
statement: Let $X$ be a nonempty proper locally Noetherian scheme over a field $k$ [def-weil-proper-morphism] with finite dimension [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], and let $\mathcal F$ be a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent] with no embedded associated points and support equal to $X$. Let $\mathcal L$ be an invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-sc-invertible-module]. Write $K_X$ for the total-quotient sheaf obtained by localizing $\mathcal O_X$ at its non-zero-divisors, and $K_X(\mathcal L):=K_X\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal L$ for its meromorphic-section sheaf. Let $s$ be a meromorphic section of $\mathcal L$ such that the canonical map $K_X\to K_X(\mathcal L)$ given by $1\mapsto s$ is injective (this is the regular-meromorphic-section condition), and let $\mathcal I$ be its denominator ideal, the subsheaf of $\mathcal O_X$ whose sections $a$ satisfy $a s\in\mathcal L$. Then the canonical maps $\mathcal I\mathcal F\to\mathcal F$ and $\mathcal I\mathcal F\to\mathcal F\otimes\mathcal L$ are injective and their cokernels $\mathcal Q$ and $\mathcal Q'$ are coherent with $\dim(\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal Q)),\dim(\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal Q'))<\dim X$. Moreover, for every integer $n$, $\chi(X,\mathcal F\otimes\mathcal L^{\otimes(n+1)})-\chi(X,\mathcal F\otimes\mathcal L^{\otimes n})=\chi(X,\mathcal Q'\otimes\mathcal L^{\otimes n})-\chi(X,\mathcal Q\otimes\mathcal L^{\otimes n})$.

proof.text: Use [lem-sc-hilbert-denominator-maps] to obtain the canonical jF, its factorization and injectivity, and the two pointwise cokernel-support implications. The denominator ideal lemma supplies its quasi-coherence and the closed nowhere-dense sets containing the supports of coker(i) and coker(j).

Quasi-coherent tensor products and closure under cokernels and kernels make image(i tensor F to F) quasi-coherent: identify the categorical image with the abelian kernel of the cokernel. Apply coherent submodule and cokernel closure to this image inside F. Coherence of F tensor L follows from the quasi-coherent finite-type criterion and tensoring by an invertible module. This proves coherence of both desired cokernels without an affine product-section identification.

The support implications of the maps lemma place both nonzero-stalk loci inside the respective closed nowhere-dense sets. The subtype inclusion is inducing, so topological Krull dimension of each support is at most that of its containing closed set. Apply [lem-sc-hilbert-nowhere-dense-dimension-drop] to get both strict inequalities.

Coherent affine sections are finite over Noetherian section rings, hence finitely presented. The affine finite-presentation criterion and the affine open cover give finite presentation of F and its coherent image. For every integer n, P=L^n is invertible. Apply the already-proved source theorem eulerChar_tensorObj_sub_eulerChar_tensorObj_eq in Modules.HilbertPolynomial (the twisted consequence of [lem-pc-euler-additive]) to each injection. Its kernel term is zero, so chi(B tensor P)=chi(A tensor P)+chi(coker tensor P). Prove L tensor L^n is isomorphic to L^(n+1) by the tensor-power recursion when n is nonnegative, dual evaluation at n=-1, and associativity and dual cancellation when n<-1. Euler invariance under this isomorphism identifies the second middle term, and subtraction cancels the common image term.

proof_origin.place: Tag 02P2; kernel comparison isolates its affine multiplication argument. The Lean proof constructs the global image factor categorically and proves coherence and support bounds. Integer-twist Euler subtraction follows Varieties Tag 0BEM using the existing proved four-term Euler identity in WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.Modules.HilbertPolynomial.
